projects.pricingRationale: TLS Virtual 1.0.0 is an executable rotating-machine simulation and diagnostic demonstrator. The 22 July 2026 retained build verification records 15 pytest successes, a passing wheel/JavaScript/CLI/API smoke, and eight deterministic simulated scenarios. It does not validate real machinery, sensor calibration, predictive-maintenance accuracy or deployment suitability. The EUR 195,000 ask and EUR 650,000 recreation estimate are dated seller references without a complete role/work-package reproduction budget.

projects.title: Research Intelligence Fabric

A configured runner is not proof that the exact current multi-service stack passed with authorized live provider credentials. The EUR 282,000 dated ask is distinct from an older EUR 280,000 source dossier; EUR 856,500 recreation includes an EUR 850,000 unbroken-down seller anchor plus EUR 6,500 scoped work. No independent hosted reliability or current market value is established.

projects.title: AEGIS Vision — Evidence-Governed Visual Intelligence Platform
projects.pricingRationale: AEGIS Vision 2.9.0 implements evidence-governed image analysis, model provenance, dataset and benchmark governance, deterministic release readiness and observation-driven requalification. Its 16 October 2026 internal verification report records 130 passing tests and 90.88% measured core coverage against an 85% floor; this is internal evidence, not an independent v2.9 release re-run. External CUDA PASS remains bound to v2.3.3. It does not validate provider-managed weights, representative visual accuracy, always-on monitoring or production approval. EUR 354,500 is a dated seller ask; EUR 1,165,000 reproduction estimate includes an EUR 15,000 scoped increment on a legacy EUR 1,150,000 base.
